dataType.name: SensingDataType
dataType.description:
A 4-byte hexadecimal value representing a sensing data type. A sensing data type identifies the format of the sensing measurement data, e.g. {{bibref|802.11bf|Section 9.4.1.81}} or vendor-specific.
The first three bytes represent either the CID (Company Identifier) or OUI (Organizationally Unique Identifier) assigned and registered by the IEEE Registration Authority.
The last byte identifies the format belonging to the CID, or OUI.
The value of 000FAC00 represents the format defined in {{bibref|802.11bf|Section 9.4.1.81}}. See {{bibref|EasyMesh|Section 21.2, Sensing Capabilities}}.

dataType.name: SensingExchangeType

parameter.name: MaxTxBandwidth
parameter.description: Indicates the maximum bandwidth in {{units}} supported for any sensing NDP (null data physical layer protocol data unit) transmission.

parameter.name: MaxTxSTSLE80MHz
parameter.description: Indicates the maximum number of STS (space-time streams) supported for any sensing NDP transmission using bandwidths less than or equal to 80 MHz.

parameter.name: MaxTxSTS160MHz
parameter.description: Indicates the maximum number of STS supported for any sensing NDP transmission using a bandwidth equal to 160 MHz.

parameter.name: MaxTxSTS320MHz
parameter.description: Indicates the maximum number of STS supported for any sensing NDP transmission using a bandwidth equal to 320 MHz.

parameter.name: MaxRxSTSLE80MHz
parameter.description: Indicates the maximum number of STS supported for any sensing NDP reception using bandwidths less than or equal to 80 MHz.

parameter.name: MaxRxSTS160MHz
parameter.description: Indicates the maximum number of STS supported for any sensing NDP reception using a bandwidth equal to 160 MHz.

parameter.name: MaxRxSTS320MHz
parameter.description: Indicates the maximum number of STS supported for any sensing NDP reception using a bandwidth equal to 320 MHz.

parameter.name: MaxTxLTFRepetition
parameter.description: Indicates the maximum number of LTF (long training field) repetitions minus 1 supported for any sensing NDP transmission.

parameter.name: MaxRxLTFRepetition
parameter.description: Indicates the maximum number of LTF repetitions minus 1 supported for any sensing NDP reception.

parameter.name: MaxTxLTFTotal
parameter.description: Indicates the maximum total number of LTF repetitions supported for any sensing NDP transmission, which includes all STS.

parameter.name: MaxRxLTFTotal
parameter.description: Indicates the maximum total number of LTF repetitions supported for any sensing NDP reception, which includes all STS.

parameter.name: MaxSupportedSessions
parameter.description: Indicates maximum number of concurrent sessions supported as a Sensing Responder.

parameter.name: MinMeasurementInterval
parameter.description: Indicates the minimum time between two consecutive non-TB (non-trigger-based) measurement exchanges, in {{units}}.

parameter.name: Sensing20MHzOnlyTx
parameter.description: Indicates support for a Sensing Transmitter role only in a bandwidth of 20 MHz.

parameter.name: SensingPeriod
parameter.description:
The requested period to perform the sensing measurement exchange in {{units}} intervals, where 1 TU = 1024 microseconds.
Note: A value of 0 identifies a one-shot measurement.

parameter.name: SensingBandwidth
parameter.description:
Requested bandwidth in {{units}}, on which to perform the sensing measurement. If not present, the maximum available bandwidth will be used.
Notes: * A bandwidth of 80+80MHz is not supported.

parameter.name: SensingNTx
parameter.description: Requested number of transmit chains to use. This only applies to Advanced sensing exchange types {{bibref|EasyMesh|Section 21.6, Sensing Operation Advanced}}. When not applicable then set to a value of 0.

parameter.name: SensingNRx
parameter.description: Requested number of receive chains to use. This only applies to Advanced sensing exchange types {{bibref|EasyMesh|Section 21.6, Sensing Operation Advanced}}. When not applicable then set to a value of 0.

parameter.name: SensingLTFRep
parameter.description: Requested number of LTF (long training field) repetitions per STS (space-time stream). This only applies to Advanced sensing TB (trigger-based) and non-TB (non-trigger-based) exchange types {{bibref|EasyMesh|Section 21.6, Sensing Operation Advanced}}. When not applicable then set to a value of 0.

parameter.name: SensingExchangeType
parameter.description: The type of measurement exchange to create.

parameter.name: SensingDataType
parameter.description: The data type format of the sensing measurement results.

parameter.name: TransmitterMACAddress
parameter.description: MAC address of the sensing transmitter.

parameter.name: ReceiverMACAddress
parameter.description: MAC address of the sensing receiver.

parameter.name: MeasurementsRequested
parameter.description:
Indicates if sensing measurement results are sent to the established Layer3Path, or not.
: {{true}}: sensing measurement results are sent to the established Layer3Path.
: {{false}}: sensing measurement results are not sent to the established Layer3Path.

object.name: Device.WiFi.Sensing.
object.description: This object represents the Wi-Fi Alliance Sensing functionality on local Wi-Fi radios for Basic and Advanced functionality as defined in {{bibref|EasyMesh|Section 21, Sensing}}.

parameter.name: SessionNumberOfEntries
parameter.description: {{numentries}}

object.name: Device.WiFi.Sensing.Session.{i}.
object.description: This object represents a sensing session, which is a connection from a client sensing application.

parameter.name: ApplicationName
parameter.description: Name or identifier of the sensing application which has created the {{object}} instance.

parameter.name: SessionID
parameter.description: Unique session identifier, as communicated by the lower-layer implementation.

parameter.name: ExchangeNumberOfEntries
parameter.description: {{numentries}}

parameter.name: DataSocketPath
parameter.description:
The destination path and filename for a UNIX domain socket of type SOCK_SEQPACKET, which an application can use to obtain sensing measurement data for all exchanges belonging to this session. The format is the URI scheme file {{bibref|RFC8089|The file URI Scheme}}.
Note: Any sensing measurement data obtained while no application is connected to the socket may be discarded.

object.name: Device.WiFi.Sensing.Session.{i}.Exchange.{i}.
object.description: This object represents a specific measurement exchange created by a sensing application.

parameter.name: SensingExchangeID
parameter.description: Indicates the unique Sensing Exchange ID corresponding to this exchange {{bibref|EasyMesh|Section 17.2.116, Sensing Exchange Request TLV}}.

parameter.name: DeviceRef
parameter.description: {{param}} specifies the Multi-AP Agent which initiates the sensing exchange.
